intro.text: Team Patel is Devang Patel and Pinky Parikh at Douglas Elliman's Setauket office. For nearly a decade they've helped Long Island buyers and sellers with homes, commercial property, and probate and estate sales, earning Douglas Elliman's 2026 Ellies Diamond Award for the top 6% of agents. They speak English, Hindi, Gujarati, Urdu and Punjabi.
